data.long_meaning: The name Juri is derived from the Sanskrit word 'jvala' which means 'radiant' or 'light'. In Hindu mythology, Juri is a name given to the Sun God, Surya, who is the symbol of light, power, and energy. The name is also associated with courage, strength, and wisdom. The name Juri carries the meaning “Radiant, Light” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Juri usually hope their child will grow to embody radiant, light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
